cells.subject: {event_title}
cells.body:
Hi {first_name},

This is the month most {icp_industry} teams decide how they'll handle {topic} for the rest of the year.

Most are still talking about it. A smaller group has already stopped relying on {old_way} and put a system in its place, and the distance between those two groups gets wider every quarter.

What's changed: for the teams ahead of you, this isn't an experiment any more. They already have {desired_outcome}, while everyone else is still {pain_point}.

We're running a focused {duration} live session on {date} at {time}. Your calendar shows it in your own time zone.

WHAT WE'LL COVER

— The {mechanism_name}: the steps ({mechanism_steps}) and the order that makes them stick.

— The economics: what {old_way} really costs a team your size, against {benchmark}.

— The build: the templates, checklists and scripts we use, yours to put in place the same week.

— A live walkthrough: {deliverable} built on screen, start to finish, with your questions answered as we go.

WHY NOW

Put this in place this month and it compounds for the rest of the year. Wait a quarter and you're catching up with teams who didn't.

WHAT YOU GET AFTERWARDS

{deliverables}, plus the full recording.

DESIGNED FOR

{icp_role} and their teams at {icp_size} companies in {icp_region} who want {desired_outcome} without adding headcount.

HOSTED BY

{host_name}, {host_role} at {company_name}. {social_proof}

Save your seat: {registration_link}

How to reply: Yes or Maybe and we'll send you the join link and reminders. No, and you won't hear from us about this event again.

P.S. {first_name}, if your team has already tried to fix {pain_point} and it didn't hold, the session covers the part most vendors skip: how the pieces connect.

cells.body:
{first_name}, here are the three leaks from the session, for anyone who'd rather read than watch:

1. The idle tax. {pain_cost}, paid every day whether or not anything changed.
2. The default nobody revisited. A setting switched on for everything, including the work that gets nothing from it.
3. The slow failure. Work that runs for hours before it breaks, and gets paid for anyway.

You won't find any of them on the invoice. You find them a quarter later, when someone asks why the number went up.

Full teardown {date}: {registration_link}

{host_first_name}

messages.body: {first_name}, {personal_line} I spend my days with {icp_role} teams on {pillar}. No pitch, it just looks like we work on the same headaches. Worth connecting?

Good to be connected, {first_name}.

Nothing to sell you here. Most of my conversations with people in your seat come back to a single question: why {pillar} keeps costing more than it gives back.

The line I hear most: "{hook}"

Does that sound like {prospect_company}, or is it handled?

{first_name}, even if this isn't a live issue for you, here's a quick check.

Take last month's {pillar} numbers and mark every day that ended in {pain_cost}. Then ask who could have seen it coming at 7am.

The count usually surprises people.

Nothing to click and no ask. It takes ten minutes and one export.

{first_name}, final message from me.

If you'd rather not do it alone, we do a 30-minute working session on your own numbers. You bring last month's data, that's all.

{booking_link}

And if this quarter is already full, that's fine. The {lead_magnet} is yours regardless.

Reply with any questions; I read every one.

messages.body: Hi {first_name}! Hope today changed how you think about {pain_point}. The next step is doing it. On the {call_name} we look at your current process, map what fits, plan the route to {desired_outcome}, and say so if we can't help. 👉 {booking_link}. P.S. Something in the way? Just reply. {host_first_name}

cells.subtitle: 24h · Have you watched the replay yet?
cells.subject: Have you watched the replay yet?
cells.body: Hi {first_name}, a quick follow-up from yesterday. Have you had a chance to watch the replay ({replay_link}), open the resources, or think about where you'd start? Here's the honest pattern: most people leave a session fired up and then go back to {old_way}. The teams that get {desired_outcome} are the ones that put a system in place. That's what {offer_name} is: we build it with you, around your team. Our record: a {client_type}, {result_metric}. Want to see whether it would work for you? Book a {call_name}: {booking_link}. {host_first_name}. P.S. Planning to do it yourself? That's fine. Just ask how long it will take, and what waiting costs.

messages.body: Hi {first_name}, the replay is up: {replay_link}. To apply it to your team, book a call: {booking_link} - {host_first_name}

Name the objection ('this won't work for us, we're different'), concede it, then one case: where they started ({old_way}), the goal ({desired_outcome}), the three moves, the result ({result_metric}). Replay link + booking link.

cells.subtitle: 48h · The mistake I see most {icp_role}s make
cells.subject: The mistake I see most {icp_role}s make
cells.body: Hi {first_name}, after years of looking at teams like yours, the same mistake keeps coming up: trying to build all of it alone. The session gets you excited, and then months go into learning tools, patching things together and writing steps that don't land, while a competitor who brought in help is already seeing results. Your time is worth more than the cost of doing it right. Your job is to lead the team and win the work, not to become the in-house expert on {category}. That's why we built {offer_name}: {deliverables}. {guarantee}. Want to see whether you're a fit? {booking_link}. {host_first_name}

messages.body: Thanks for joining, {first_name}. What was your biggest takeaway? Just reply here. Plan for your team: {booking_link} - {host_first_name}
Your competitors are already moving off {old_way}. Here's how a {client_type} put it: "{testimonial}". Three things you'll see on the call. Booking link.

cells.subtitle: 72h · Last note on the {call_name}
cells.subject: Last note on the {call_name}
cells.body: Hi {first_name}, this is my last email about the {call_name}. After this I'll assume one of three things: it's not the right time, you're building it yourself, or you already have someone helping. All of those are fine. But if you've been on the fence: the call is free, with no obligation. In 30 minutes we cover how you handle this today, your biggest bottleneck, a plan to {desired_outcome}, and whether {offer_name} fits. Even if we never work together, you'll leave knowing where the process breaks, what to fix first and a realistic timeline. {booking_link}. {host_first_name}. P.S. What does another quarter of {pain_point} cost you?

messages.body: Last one from me: call slots for this round close tonight. {booking_link} - {host_first_name}, {company_name}. Reply STOP to opt out

Last message on this. Don't wait for perfect conditions. Four things you leave the call with. If the slots are gone, the next ones open after the {next_date} session. Risk reversal: {guarantee}. Booking link.
